Entra aquí RedacciónBarcelonaActualizado el 19/10/2025 02:35 EDTMexican content creator Karely Ruiz secured a decisive victory in the main event of Stream Fighters 4, proving that her training camp paid off. Ruiz overpowered Colombian rival Karina García, sealing the fight with a third-round technical knockout that electrified the audience.Ruiz’s power and determination stand out From the opening bell, Ruiz showcased her aggressive style and relentless determination. Her power punches and sharp combinations quickly set the tone, leaving García on the defensive.By the third round, Ruiz’s dominance was clear as she forced the stoppage, marking one of the most impressive performances of the night. García’s effort in defeatDespite her lack of boxing background, Karina García stepped into the ring with heart and courage. The Colombian relied on sheer determination to push back against Ruiz’s onslaught.Strengths: unwavering spirit, resilience under pressureWeaknesses: limited technique, visible fatigue by the third roundUltimately, exhaustion caught up with her, opening the door for Ruiz to close the fight with authority.
